note: The [one-key] case: group (value, key) with key withheld keeps one member, so the group itself is withheld (old: no variable_groups, last diagnostic withheld_output variable_group:<register>/<key>, the cause's refs). [key-absent] (no member left) is the easier case of the same two-member rule.
fails_if: `resolve_metadata_dependencies` (catalog_dependencies.py) writes a group once its parent resolves, without the `len(members) >= 2` check, so the pair group is built with value alone
